Why COPD Fuel needs Health Connect access

COPD Fuel is a health tracking app for people with COPD. To import your data from your watch or phone (e.g. Samsung Health, Wear OS), we need read access to:

• Oxygen saturation (SpO2) – to show your oxygen readings in the app
• Weight – to show your weight history
• Exercise – to show your workout sessions
• Steps – to show your daily steps
• Heart rate – to show your heart rate history

We use this data only to display and track it in the app. You can optionally share it with your doctor. We do not use it for advertising or sell it. You can revoke access anytime in Health Connect settings.
